source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Riptide Battlesuit errata.

[Nova Charge](vsdata:ability/tau-empire.riptide-battlesuit.nova-charge): once per battle, in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), as you select this unit to shoot, pick 1 ranged weapon on the model; it has **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)** until that phase ends.

Both Ion accelerator profiles have range 72″, 6 attacks and BS 4+:

- **Ion accelerator – standard**: Strength 9, AP -2, Damage 3
- **Ion accelerator – supercharge**: Strength 10, AP -3, Damage 4, **[[HAZARDOUS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/hazardous)**

faq.timing: unit selected to shoot, own Shooting phase
faq.select: one ranged weapon equipped by this model
